title: KW Escape
specs: Games designed to be fun and challenging without being scary except Taken
Games include multi-room and one-room escape experiences
Recommended minimum 4 players; 2 players allowed but may not complete all tasks
Children 8-10 can play only with adult supervision in family setting
Children 11-13 can play with at least one adult (18+) for get togethers
Children under 14 need participating adult supervisors
No birthday parties for children under age 11 (some games) or under 14 (Taken)
Some games require comfortable clothing and closed toe shoes due to physical activity
Private games only; no mixing with other groups
Party room fits up to 30 people; facility can host up to 150 people
